answer: Each new agent must submit a cedar‑signed attestation encrypted in an opal‑key pair, then solve a time‑locked prism puzzle that only releases a credential after a 48‑hour proof‑of‑work window. The puzzle’s hash includes the previous block’s credential, so a Sybil must repeat the full attestation and mining cycle for every fake identity. The attacker pays a fixed cost of 0.02 ETH per identity plus a 48‑hour lock‑up before any credential becomes usable, making mass‑scale fakes economically prohibitive.
